definition: to tease someone by offering something desirable then keeping it out of reach
hook: To tantalize someone is to sentence them to a Greek king's eternal punishment.
modernAnchor: A tantalizing smell drifts from the kitchen. A tantalizing offer you cannot quite reach.

origin.originalMeaning: Tantalus, a king punished by the gods in the underworld

journey: In Greek myth, King Tantalus offended the gods and was sentenced to a perfect torment.
He stood forever in a pool of water beneath a tree heavy with ripe fruit.
When he bent to drink, the water drained away. When he reached up, the branches lifted.
Desire forever within sight, forever out of reach. From his name we built the verb tantalize.
